mentions.name: Gaming Couch
mentions.description: This is a web-based local multiplayer party game platform, described as a lovechild of Jackbox Games and Mario Party. It is in free Early Access with 19 competitive, action-based mini-games supporting up to 8 players with quick one-minute rounds (no language-based trivia or asynchronous games). Players use mobile phones or gamepads as controllers, and everything is fully web-based with no downloads or installs. Third-party development tools are in progress so anyone can build and ship a simple multiplayer party game for the platform, ideally in a single weekend.
mentions.audience: Party game players playing together locally, and game developers or aspiring game devs who want to build and ship their own party games for the platform
